name: Zen Lotus Pond
subtitle: Lotus water garden
displayTitle: ZEN LOTUS POND — WATER GARDEN PLAN
lede: Brownstone rectangular lotus pond with Buddha, jasmine, gentle moving water and low-maintenance filtration.
nextAction: Choose the permanent main pump and mechanical/biological filter for the Brownstone Manhattan pond.
goals: Clean moving water with predictable upkeep
Start fishless while making the filtration fish-ready for a possible future addition

siteConstraints.climate: Very hot Arizona summers; temperatures can reach about 110°F
siteConstraints.location: Final placement — front courtyard/patio or backyard patio — will be confirmed in Phase 4
siteConstraints.maintenanceTarget: A few minutes weekly plus periodic filter cleaning
siteConstraints.designIntent: Brownstone rectangular pond with lotus, Buddha, gentle fountain and jasmine

budget.note: Target budget and phase estimates are maintained in the cost plan.

shopping.item: Algreen Manhattan 40-inch Balcony Planter & Pond — Brownstone

shopping.note: Use as the visible gentle fountain, not the main filter.

shopping.item: Adjustable main pond pump, approximately 300–500 GPH rated
Tubing, flow control and quiet return fittings

shopping.note: Buy only if the chosen location is not already flat, level and stable.

shopping.item: Jasmine plants — reuse existing if suitable, otherwise buy two

phases.name: Lotus Nursery
phases.summary: Keep the lotus seedlings healthy while the permanent pond is built.

phases.name: Pond Selection
phases.summary: Brownstone Algreen Manhattan pond purchased from Wayfair for $146.19 all-in.

phases.name: Pump + Filter + Fountain
phases.summary: Install permanent circulation and filtration sized for the pond now and possible small fish later.
requirements: Keep the Smartpond kit as the gentle visible fountain
Add an adjustable 300–500 GPH main pump
Add mechanical + biological filtration with bio-media
Connect with tubing, flow control and a quiet return

phases.name: Pond Placement + Setup
phases.summary: Choose the final location, level the Manhattan pond and test the setup before planting.
requirements: Choose front courtyard/patio or backyard patio
Confirm sun exposure, heat, power access and maintenance access
Set the pond on a flat, level and stable surface
Plan pump/filter placement and cable routing
Fill and leak-test before moving the lotus

phases.name: Jasmine Frame
phases.summary: Frame the pond with jasmine while keeping the composition light and uncluttered.
requirements: Use two white planters
Use two black trellises
Keep jasmine growth airy rather than forming a dense wall

phases.name: Lotus + Buddha
phases.summary: Move the lotus into the permanent pond and finish the central Zen composition.
requirements: Transfer the established lotus into the Manhattan
Place Buddha beside the lotus
Keep the gentle fountain opposite the lotus
Preserve open reflective water

phases.name: Lighting + Finishing
phases.summary: Add restrained warm lighting and finish the visible details after the pond is stable.
requirements: Warm accent light on jasmine
Subtle Buddha accent
Hide and secure visible wiring/hardware

phases.name: Future Fish Decision
phases.summary: Decide whether a small fish population is appropriate after the pond has proven stable through Arizona seasons.
requirements: Review summer water temperature and oxygen
Confirm the biological filter is mature and adequate
Choose only a conservative number of small fish if conditions support them
Add testing or aeration equipment only if the future review shows it is needed

decisions.decision: Brownstone Algreen Manhattan 40-inch pond purchased from Wayfair.
Choose front courtyard/patio or backyard patio in Phase 4.
Start fishless; revisit a small fish population in about one year.

maintenance.task: Remove debris/string algae and check water level
